concerns.text: FR-002 requires loading a 'B SSM student' (text appears truncated/typoed as 'B' instead of '1.3B'). The plan.md mentions 'Mamba-1.3B' in Section 3.2, but the spec requirement text itself is malformed, creating ambiguity in the requirement definition.

FR-007 states 'falling back to a hard limit of a minimal number' without specifying the number (e.g., 1). The plan.md Section 3.2 specifies 'Batch Size: 1', but the spec requirement is incomplete, leaving the success criterion for FR-007 undefined in the source spec.

SC-006 requires measuring log-probability validity 'against human-verified correctness labels on a held-out subset'. The plan.md (Section 2, 3.3) and data-model.md (Section 3.1) describe using AIME 2024 with ground-truth reasoning steps, but do not mention a separate 'human-verified' subset or process. The plan does not address the specific measurement method required by SC-006.

FR-009 requires evaluating on a 'held-out set of unseen problems'. The plan.md (Section 2) mentions 'AIME 2024 (Test)' as a held-out evaluation set, but the spec's SC-006 (linked to FR-009) adds a specific 'human-verified' constraint not addressed in the plan's dataset strategy. The plan assumes the AIME test set is sufficient without addressing the 'human-verified' aspect of SC-006.
